offers.intro: I work one-to-one with executives to put AI to work on a real priority. We can connect your tools, build something useful, or work through a decision together.

examples.title: Put your context to work
examples.text: Connect meeting notes and documents. Explore plugins and reusable skills.

examples.title: Stay informed
examples.text: Build a research workflow around your industry, competitors, and emerging technology.

examples.title: Make something useful
examples.text: Create a first dashboard, decision tool, or prototype around a business question.

offers.photoAlt: Ariba Jahan working with a group around a table and a wall of workshop notes
offers.intro: I work with product and business leaders to identify where growth, relevance, and differentiation can come from next, then make the strongest opportunities tangible.

examples.title: Understand what is changing
examples.text: Examine customer needs and where the current experience falls short.

examples.title: Find the opportunity
examples.text: Define where your product, service, or customer experience can become more valuable.

examples.title: Make it tangible
examples.text: Develop concepts and prototypes your team can evaluate and test.

offers.photoAlt: Ariba Jahan speaking on a panel at the Marketing Brew Summit
offers.intro: I work with leaders and teams to choose where AI belongs in their work, test an approach with the people doing it, and build the practices to keep it useful.

examples.title: Choose where to start
examples.text: Identify a workflow where AI can improve the work and draw on existing expertise.

examples.title: Test it together
examples.text: Work through handoffs, responsibilities, and decisions that need human judgment.

examples.title: Build shared capability
examples.text: Define the practices your team needs and what successful adoption looks like.
